neighbours.label: Uses division to rescale a numerical quantity or obtain a ratio from measured values.
fire: To estimate the average fare, divide the total revenue by the number of passengers.
The recipe's conversion rule divides every ingredient weight by four.
Compute the unit cost by dividing the invoice amount by the quantity delivered.
For the normalized score, divide each observed value by the largest value in the series.
The technician divided the measured distance by elapsed time to calculate the speed.
To recover the original scale, divide the enlarged dimensions by the magnification factor.
The analyst divides annual profit by invested capital to obtain a return ratio.
Find the rate per minute by dividing the event count by the duration of the recording.
quiet: The accountant recorded the total revenue and the number of passengers in adjacent columns.
The revised recipe lists all ingredient weights in a table beside the instructions.
A wooden divider separates the delivered supplies from goods awaiting shipment.
The researcher wrote the observed values in a column and highlighted the largest entry.
The technician measured distance and elapsed time during each trial of the experiment.
A thin partition divides the enlarged exhibition space into two separate galleries.
The analyst compared the annual profit with the figures from the previous report.
The editor chose to divide the recording into separate chapters for each speaker.

notes: Probes separated arithmetic divide from spatial divide. Multiplication, square roots and logarithms can also activate this pole, so numerical division is a candidate subfunction. The opposite pole contains resulting dimensions and spatial intervals.
